name: nzyme
description: Claude Code plugins for projects built on the @nzyme framework packages

plugins.name: nzyme
plugins.description: How to use the @nzyme framework packages — dependency injection, logging, translations, Vue forms and composables — plus the TypeScript conventions and testing practice they are written for, and the reference architecture of a product repo (/nzyme:architecture) with its UI, Drizzle and API-client practice

plugins.name: nzyme-ui
plugins.description: Building Vue UI components the nzyme way, on @nzyme/vue-forms primitives and reka-ui, with SCSS tokens, stories and WCAG 2.2 AA story tests. For repos with a UI package.

plugins.name: nzyme-drizzle
plugins.description: SQL with Drizzle the nzyme way: schema, queries, transactions and migrations. For repos with a SQL database.

plugins.name: nzyme-api-clients
plugins.description: Third-party API clients the nzyme way: one package per vendor, committed specs, offline codegen. For repos that integrate external APIs.
